title.narrative: Mapping Police Protocols and Institutional Responses to LGBTQIA+phobic violence in Brazil

description.narrative: The main objective is to develop Brazil’s first national mapping of police protocols and institutional responses to LGBTQIA+phobic violence, exposing gaps, procedural failures, and barriers to justice. Impact: Strengthen the implementation of public policies and public security protocols to combat violence against LGBTQIA+ individuals, promoting inclusive, democratic and rights-based institutional practices. Outcome 1: Increased institutional awareness of procedural gaps, improved access to information for victims and advocates, and strengthened advocacy capacity for rights-based security policies. Output 1.1: Creation of Mapping of police protocols and institutional responses to LGBTQIA+phobic violence in Brazil, in print and online format. Output 1.2: Conduction of strategic consultations with key stakeholders for co-creation of the tool. Output 1.3: Organization of a national launch events in Brasilia and strategic dissemination of the Mapping. Target group: Brazilian LGBTQIA+ organizations, law enforcement officers, justice system actors, LGBTQIA+ parliamentarians, and human right defenders.
